addictionPotential: 中度成瘾且滥用潜力高。
summary: 一种兴奋剂与共情剂。与 MDMA 相似但通常更具视觉效果。已知比 MDMA 更具神经毒性，并是 MDMA 的次要代谢物。持续时间与起效类似 MDMA。常用 Marquis 试剂无法区分 MDA 与 MDMA。
effectsSummary: MDA is an entactogen with stimulating and mild psychedelic effects. Increased empathy, euphoria, enhanced sensory perception, mild visual distortions.
dosageRemark: MDA is more neurotoxic than MDMA. Use less frequently and at lower doses.
generalRisks: Neurotoxic risk is higher than with MDMA. Hyperthermia, serotonin syndrome. Jaw clenching, teeth grinding. Increased heart rate and blood pressure.
longtermRisks: Regular use may cause neurotoxicity and serotonin system damage. Potential for cognitive deficits and depression.
saferUse: 保持水分但不要过量饮水。
不要频繁使用（建议间隔 3 个月以上）。
